purpose: Document Parbhani's official local cadastral custodian, Maharashtra Bhu-Naksha discovery, and bounded anonymous requests while separating registry evidence from geometry and runtime qualification.
assessment: The official Parbhani district page establishes a local District Superintendent of Land Records and property-survey function. Official Maharashtra pages describe Bhu-Naksha and city-survey map availability, but the bounded live service request timed out before its JavaScript/configuration or parcel API could be inspected. No safe native ID, schema, CRS, or polygon geometry was verified, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Parbhani district Land Records Department page naming the district custodian and survey responsibilities, reinforced by the Maharashtra Bhu-Naksha project page naming Parbhani. This does not establish citywide geometry completeness or title/ownership information.
